blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Video world models are used as simulators, so when a first frame leaves several physical outcomes open, repeated generations should produce each outcome as often as it occurs in the data. Physics post-training scores every generation against the single recorded future of its history, which makes single videos more faithful, but the expected score is linear in the model distribution and is maximized by always producing the most likely outcome. The log-likelihood of the recorded outcome is maximized by the data distribution, and its gradient weights agreement with the record by the inverse of how often the model produces the generated outcome, a frequency that other generations of the same history with independent noise, its siblings, can estimate. To train with this weight from a finite group, we propose SibPO, which performs Sibling-paired Policy Optimization: siblings estimate a truncated inverse-frequency weight for agreement with the record, and a second term subtracts the same weight times the agreement with the siblings, which makes the expected objective a strictly proper divergence over outcome cells at every group size. On PisaBench, SibPO lowers the KS distance to simulated landing times by 9.1-10.2% relative to the strongest method outside its reward family on three of four video models without degrading single videos, and it lowers the error of estimated robot policy success rates by 13%.
blocks.zh: 视频世界模型被用作模拟器,因此当第一个帧留下几个物理结果打开时,重复代应像数据中发生的那样频繁地产生每个结果. 物理训练后的分数每代都与其历史的单曲录制的未来相对比,这使得单曲录制的视频更加忠实,但预期的分数在模型发行中是线性的,并且总是通过产生最可能的结果而最大化. 记录结果的对数相似性通过数据分布得到最大化,其梯度权重与记录一致,相反的是模型产生生成结果的频率,这个频率是具有独立噪音的同一历史其他几代人,其兄弟姐妹可以估计的. 为了从一个有限的群体中培养这种重量,我们提议SibPO,它执行兄弟般的政策优化:兄弟姐妹们估计与记录一致的截断反频率重量,第二个术语减去与兄弟姐妹们的协议的相同重量倍,这使预期目标在每组规模上对结果细胞形成严格的适当差异。 在比萨奔奇上,SibPO将KS距离降低到模拟着陆时间,比其奖励家族以外的最强方法在4个视频模型中3个没有贬低单个视频,将估计机器人政策成功率的误差降低13%.

blocks.en:
Video generation models continue a scene from a single frame with plausible motion, so they serve as world models that sample futures of an observed history, for instance to estimate robot policy success rates from imagined rollouts.
A single image, however, leaves part of the physics open. The frame in Figure 1 does not show whether the falling red cloth will touch the yellow object, so the correct output is a distribution over both outcomes.
Evaluation has therefore moved from whether each video looks plausible [ 5 , 6 , 31 ] to whether repeated generations reproduce the probabilities of the physically possible outcomes [ 35 , 37 ] .
blocks.zh:
视频生成模型从一个单一的框架继续一个场景,具有可信的运动,因此它们充当了世界模型,对所观察历史的未来进行抽样,例如从想象的推出中估算机器人政策成功率。
然而,一个单一的图像留下了部分物理的开放. 图1中的框没有显示落下的红布是否会触碰黄色物体,因此正确的输出是两种结果的分布.
因此,评价已经从每段视频看起来是否合理[5、6、31],到重复几代人是否重复了实际可能结果的概率[35、37]。

blocks.en:
Post-training makes video world models physically more faithful along two routes. The first route scores each generation against the recorded future of its history, through perceptual error [ 49 ] , agreement of masks, optical flow or depth [ 21 ] or preferences among recorded continuations [ 22 ] , often with group policy gradients [ 27 , 46 ] , and makes single videos more faithful than likelihood fine-tuning.
The second route counters the resulting loss of diversity with diversity rewards [ 26 , 18 ] or a divergence to the initial model [ 23 ] , and the weight of this term decides how much spread survives.
Neither route gives the outcome frequencies a target that the data define.
No system evaluated on PAWBench reproduces the reference outcome probabilities [ 35 ] , and the physics post-trained checkpoints of PISA [ 21 ] lower the real-video trajectory error from 7.6 7.6 to 6.7 6.7 – 7.5 × 10 − 2 7.5\times 10^{-2} while their landing-time spread shrinks from 0.81 0.81 to 0.63 0.63 – 0.74 0.74 of the simulated width ( Appendix E ).
blocks.zh:
后训练使影视世界模型沿着两条路线实际更加忠实. 首条路由每代人通过感知错误[49],口罩的一致,光学流或深度[21]或记录续作的偏好[22],对照其历史记录的未来来评分,往往采用集团政策梯度[27,46],使单段视频比概率微调更忠实.
第二种途径以多样性奖励[26,18]或与初始模型[23]的分歧来抵消由此造成的多样性的丧失,这一术语的权重决定了传播的传播量。
两者都不给结果频率一个数据定义的目标.
PAWBench上评价的系统没有复制参考结果概率[35],PISA[21]的物理训练后检查点将真视频轨迹误差从7.6 7.6降至6.7 6.7 – 7.5 × 10 – 2 7.5 时 10 → 2 → 2 → 2 ,而其着陆时间差则从模拟宽度的0.81 0.81缩小至0.63 0.63 – 0.74 0.74(附录E)。

blocks.en:
We therefore study the following problem. When a video world model is post-trained through an outcome readout, a frozen program that reads the outcome of interest from a video, and every history comes with a single recorded future, what determines the outcome frequencies of its repeated generations, and how can these frequencies reach those of the data while the single-video gains of readout rewards and the usual number of generations are kept?
The log-likelihood of the recorded outcome is maximized by the data distribution, and its gradient rewards agreement with the record in inverse proportion to how often the model already produces the generated outcome. Only other generations of the same history drawn with independent noise, which we call the siblings of a generation, can estimate this frequency, and GRPO-style post-training already draws them.
blocks.zh:
因此,我们研究以下问题。 当一个视频世界模型通过一个结果读取,一个冷冻的程序读取一个视频中的兴趣结果,每一个历史都有一个单一的录制未来,是什么决定了它重复几代人的结果频率,这些频率如何在读取奖励的单视频收益和通常几代人保留的同时到达数据频率?
记录结果的对数相似性通过数据分布得到最大程度的实现,其梯度奖励与记录的反比比例与模型已经产生结果的频率成正比. 只有用独立噪音绘制的同一历史的其他几代人,我们称之为一代人的兄弟姐妹,才能估计这种频率,而GRPO式的后期训练已经吸引了他们。

blocks.en:
Two obstacles remain. A finite group estimates only a truncated inverse frequency, capped by the group size, and dividing the reward by it alone, as success-count normalization does [ 43 ] , removes rare outcomes from the optimum in small groups.
Once the reward of a generation depends on its siblings, the advantage estimator, which turns the rewards of a group into the weights of the policy-gradient update, also becomes part of the objective. Group normalization or initial noise shared within a group [ 51 ] then move the frequencies back toward the mode.
blocks.zh:
仍然存在两个障碍。 一个有限的群体只估计一个截断的反向频率,以群体大小为上限,并且像成功计数正常化[43]一样,将奖励单独分割开来,从小群体中的最佳结果中去除了罕见的结果.
一旦一代人的奖励取决于其兄弟姐妹,将一个群体的奖励转化为政策升级更新的权重的优势估计器也成为目标的一部分. 组合正常化或初始噪音在组合内共享 [51] 然后将频率向模式移动。

blocks.en:
To make the data distribution the unique maximizer of the expected objective of every history at every group size, we propose SibPO, which trains each generation by Sib ling-paired P olicy O ptimization and changes only how GRPO-style post-training computes rewards and advantages.
Its reward has two terms. The first weights agreement with the record by the sibling estimate of the truncated inverse frequency. The second, which we call the sibling term, subtracts the same weight times the agreement of the generation with its siblings. It cancels the truncation bias, so the expected update follows a divergence between model and data outcome frequencies that vanishes only when they are equal, and a leave-one-out baseline, a batch-constant scale and independent sibling noise keep this objective intact.
Our contributions are as follows. • We show that, with one recorded future per history, what each generation is compared with sets the outcome frequencies of readout-based post-training, and how common advantage estimators move them toward the mode. • We propose SibPO, whose sibling-estimated weight and sibling term make the data distribution the unique maximizer of the expected objective at every group size. • On four video models and an autoregressive world model, SibPO has the lowest PisaBench KS distance on three and parity on the fourth without degrading single videos, interventions reproduce each predicted estimator effect, and policy success estimates improve by 13 % 13\% .

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Prior work asks how to make single generations follow physics, how to keep the diversity that reward optimization removes and, outside video generation, which target the outcome frequencies of an ambiguous input should have.
blocks.zh: 先前的工作询问如何使单代人遵循物理学,如何保持奖励优化的多样性去除,以及外部视频生成,它针对的是模糊输入的结果频率。

blocks.en:
Besides methods that inject physical attributes [ 45 ] , distill spatio-temporal relations [ 54 ] , optimize physical preferences [ 8 ] or reward 3D and collision rules [ 46 , 53 ] , three are closest to us: PISA [ 21 ] rewards agreement of segmentation, optical flow or depth with recorded drops, RLVR-World [ 49 ] runs GRPO with the L1 plus LPIPS distance to recorded frames, and DynamicsBoost [ 22 ] prefers continuations conditioned on longer recorded prefixes.
Each reward scores one generation against one target, which fixes trajectory errors of single videos and drives an ambiguous history to its likeliest outcome ( Section 3.2 ). SibPO keeps their data and readouts and changes the comparison partner.
blocks.zh:
除了注入物理属性的方法[45],蒸馏spatio-时态关系[54],优化物理偏好[8]或奖励3D和碰撞规则[46,53]之外,三种方法最接近于我们:PISA[21]奖励分化,光学流或深度的协议有记录的下降,RLVR-World[49]运行GROPO与L1加LPIPS距离到记录帧,DynamicsBoost[22]更倾向于在记录较长的前缀上附加条件.
每个奖赏都比一个目标给一代人打分, SibPO保存他们的数据和读取,并更改比较伙伴.

blocks.en:
Flow-GRPO [ 27 ] applied the group-relative advantage of GRPO [ 39 ] to flow models through a stochastic sampler, DanceGRPO [ 51 ] shares the initial noise within a group, and the resulting diversity loss [ 19 ] is countered with cluster-based [ 26 ] or determinantal [ 18 ] rewards, corrected reward directions [ 7 ] or a forward divergence to the initial policy [ 23 ] .
The closest analysis shows that group standard-deviation normalization makes the stated probabilities of language models overconfident, while RLOO [ 1 ] and PPO [ 38 ] stay calibrated [ 3 ] .
That analysis assumes independent rewards, while with sibling-coupled rewards even mean subtraction changes the objective ( Section 5 ). A diversity weight sets a spread unrelated to the outcome distribution.
blocks.zh:
Flow-GRPO[27]将GRPO[39]的集团关系优势运用到流体标本上,DanceGRPO[51]在一个集团内部分享初始噪声,由此导致的多样性损失[19]与基于集群的[26]或决定性的[18]奖励相对应,纠正奖励指示[7]或与初始政策存在前向分歧[23].
最接近的分析显示,群体标准减法正常化使得语言模型的既定概率过高,而RLOO [1]和PPO [38]则保持校准[3].
这种分析假定有独立的奖励,而兄弟间挂钩的奖励甚至意味着减少则改变目标(第5节)。 多样性权重设定了与结果分配无关的分布.

blocks.en:
A strictly proper score such as the energy score [ 10 ] is maximized in expectation only by the true distribution and trains generative forecasters [ 34 , 40 , 9 , 20 ] through differentiable samples.
Energy-based fine-tuning (EBFT) [ 16 ] matches mean features of language-model rollouts to one reference with a reward that adds alignment with the reference and subtracts similarity to the other rollouts, and MaxRL [ 43 ] divides correctness rewards by the group success count to approach the log-likelihood of a fixed correct answer.
EBFT’s quadratic weight does not grow as an outcome becomes rare, and MaxRL’s truncated normalization becomes improper once the target outcome is random and removes rare cells in small groups. SibPO keeps the growing weight and removes the truncation bias with a sibling correction ( Section 3.2 ).
blocks.zh:
能量分数[10]等严格适当的分数,只在预期中通过不同的样本,由真正的分布并训练基因预测器[34,40,9,20]实现最大化.
基于能量的微调(EBFT) [16] 匹配语言模式推出时的平均特征与一个参考物匹配,并奖励与引用物加比,并减去了与其他推出物的相似性,MaxRL [43] 将分组成功计数的正确性奖励除以接近固定正确答案的对数.
EBFT的四重力不会随着结果变得稀有而增长,一旦目标结果随机发生并清除小组中的稀有细胞,MaxRL的短调正常化就会变得不恰当. 锡布 PO保持不断增长的重量,并用兄弟姐妹的校正来消除截断偏差(第3.2节).

blocks.zh: 4 方法

blocks.en:
SibPO turns the three requirements of Section 3.2 into an advantage computation for GRPO-style post-training and leaves the model, the data, the readout and the number of generations unchanged ( Figure 2 ).
For each history the model generates G G siblings, a frozen readout extracts their outcomes and that of the record, the sibling-paired reward compares every generation with the record and its siblings to define the proper target ( Section 4.1 ), and a leave-one-out baseline with a fixed scale ( Section 4.2 ) and independent sibling noise ( Section 4.3 ) keep the expected update on this target.

SibPO将第3.2节的三项要求转化为GRPO式的后期训练的优势计算,并留下模型,数据,读出和代数不变(图2).
对于每个历史,模型产生G G 兄弟姐妹,冷冻读取其结果和记录的结果,兄弟奖赏将每一代人与记录及其兄弟姐妹进行比较,以确定适当的目标(第4.1节),并保留一个固定比例的一出基线(第4.2节)和独立兄弟奖噪声(第4.3节),以保持这一目标的预期更新。

The sibling terms estimate model frequencies only for siblings that are independent given the history. All siblings of a group share the history, encoded once per group, and each draws its own initial noise and its own noise at every sampling step. Autoregressive models share the key-value cache of the history and sample all future tokens independently.
A training step generates G ≥ 3 G\geq 3 siblings for each of P P histories with a stochastic sampler as in Flow-GRPO [ 27 ] , stores the log-probability of every sampling transition or token, computes advantages by Eq. ( 4 ) and Eq. ( 5 ) and updates LoRA [ 14 ] parameters with the PPO clipped objective [ 38 ] and a KL penalty to the reference model ( Algorithm S1 ).
The cost equals that of GRPO, and deployment uses the training sampler ( Appendix I ).

一个培训步骤为每个P历史产生G 3 G\geq 3个兄弟姐妹,其中具有Flow-GRPO [27] 中的分色取样器,存储每个采样过渡或标物的日志概率,由 Eq. (4) 和 Eq. (5) 计算优势,并用 PPO 剪辑的目标更新 LoRA [14] 参数 [38] ,并将 KL 惩罚值改为参考模型(Algorithm S1 )。

blocks.en:
The PisaBench distribution protocol [ 21 ] gives 50 frames of a falling object whose depth the image leaves open, each with an analytic landing-time distribution. From 128 generations we report the mean per-frame KS distance and the median ratio of generated to simulated interquartile range (IQR ratio), which isolates spread and should be one.
On 1,200 Physion [ 2 ] test videos, eight continuations each give the fair Brier score, the only proper Physion metric, besides accuracy and human agreement.
Our Kubric split re-simulates 150 held-out scenes, PAWBench [ 35 ] and CaliBench [ 37 ] score untrained mechanisms such as dice, and single-video quality uses the PisaBench error on 361 real videos, Physics-IQ [ 30 ] and VBench-I2V [ 15 ] .

比萨奔驰分配协议[21]给出了50帧的坠落物体,其图像的深度未打开,每帧都有分析的落地时间分布. 从128代开始,我们报告每帧KS距离的平均值和生成与模拟的方位间距的中位比(IQR比),它们隔离分布,应该是一个.
在1200 Physion [2] 测试视频上,除了精度和人类协议之外,每集8个续集给出了公平布赖尔的得分,这是唯一合适的Physion衡量标准.
我们的Kubric分裂重新模拟了150场被搁置的场景,PAWBench [35] 和Cali Bench [37] 得分未经过训练的机制,如骰子,单视频质量在361个真实视频上使用比萨奔奇错误,Physics-IQ [30]和V Bench-I2V [15].

blocks.en:
Post-training uses PISA falling objects, the eight Physion contact scenarios and Kubric [ 11 ] throws, bounces and collisions with one recorded future per history. For held-out mechanisms, every method is retrained without the falling family, and Physion follows the all-but-one protocol [ 2 ] .
The main model is Cosmos-Predict2.5-2B [ 32 ] , and Wan2.2-TI2V-5B [ 44 ] , CogVideoX1.5-5B-I2V [ 52 ] , Cosmos-Predict2.5-14B and iVideoGPT [ 48 ] test generality. Compared methods cover rewards against the record (RLVR-World, Flow-GRPO, three PISA-ORO rewards, DynamicsBoost), diversity preservation (DiverseGRPO, DPH-RL) and flow-matching fine-tuning on recorded futures (SFT).
Two baselines isolate the weight: EBFT [ 16 ] pairs siblings through a quadratic score on frozen generator features, and SibPO with M = 0 M=0 applies this score to the readout and differs from SibPO only in the weight.
Spread-matched controls ( † ) tune guidance and sampler noise to the simulated dispersion. All methods share base weights, data, LoRA rank, G = 8 G=8 , 150 updates and the stochastic sampler, and use three seeds with 95% two-level bootstrap intervals. Training readouts use CoTracker3 [ 17 ] and SAM 2 [ 36 ] ( Appendix B ).

训练后使用PISA坠落对象,八种光电接触情景和Kubric [11] 投掷,弹跳和碰撞,每个历史记录一个未来. 对于被搁置机制,每一种方法都在没有掉落的家族的情况下被重新训练,而Physion遵循的是全但一的协议[2].
主要型号为宇宙-预测2.5-2B [32],和Wan2.2-TI2V-5B [44],CogVideoX1.5-5B-I2V [52],宇宙-预测2.5-14B和iVideoGPT [48] 测试通用性. 比较方法涵盖与记录相对应的奖励(RLVR-World,Flow-GRPO,三个PISA-ORO奖励,DynamicsBoost),多样性保护(DiversitGRPO,DPH-RL)和记录期货的流量匹配微调(SFT).
两个基线隔离重量: EBFT [16] 双胞胎兄弟姐妹通过四极分数在冷冻生成器特性上进行,而带有M=0 M=0的SibPO将这个分数应用于读取,仅在重量上不同于SibPO.

All post-training methods remove most of the landing delay of the base model, rewards against the record keep 0.55 0.55 – 0.70 0.70 of the simulated IQR against 0.86 0.86 for SibPO, and SFT keeps a wide spread ( 0.81 0.81 ) at the highest real-video error among post-training methods ( 9.4 × 10 − 2 9.4\times 10^{-2} ).
On binary Physion, rewards against the record raise the fair Brier score from 0.255 0.255 to 0.258 0.258 – 0.281 0.281 , while SibPO lowers it to 0.239 0.239 , 0.011 0.011 below SFT (95% CI: − 0.017 -0.017 – − 0.005 -0.005 ), and the less ambiguous Kubric split repeats the ordering ( 0.274 0.274 against 0.292 0.292 ).

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en:
We have shown that, with one recorded future per history, what each generation is compared with determines the outcome frequencies after video world model post-training, and that coupled rewards make the advantage estimator part of the objective.
SibPO uses siblings to estimate the inverse-frequency weight of the outcome likelihood and to correct its truncation bias, which makes the data distribution the unique maximizer at every group size.
Its quadratic member already outperforms published post-training, and the weight restores dropped outcomes faster. The analysis covers any sampler with tractable log-probabilities trained from single observations through finite readout cells.

All post-training methods share one configuration within a model family, and the four video models use the same values.
Training uses LoRA rank 64, G = 8 G=8 generations for each of P = 4 P=4 histories per update, 150 updates, a resolution of 256 × 448 256\times 448 with 25 frames, a 10-step stochastic sampler and a PPO clip range of 0.2.
Each method selects its KL weight from { 0.01 , 0.04 } \{0.01,0.04\} and its learning rate from { 1 , 3 } × 10 − 5 \{1,3\}\times 10^{-5} once on the validation split, every configuration is trained with three seeds, and each run draws 150 × 32 = 4,800 150\times 32=4{,}800 generations.
A SibPO run takes 21.6, 18.7, 28.4 and 126.0 GPU hours on Cosmos-Predict2.5-2B, Wan2.2-TI2V-5B, CogVideoX1.5-5B-I2V and Cosmos-Predict2.5-14B.
Training runs on four A100-80GB GPUs in bf16.
Evaluation follows the official resolution and duration of each benchmark, which is about 480p for the video benchmarks, with the training sampler and step count.
Training data cover five mechanism families: the public PISA simulated drop videos, the Physion training split, and throws, bounces and collisions of rigid objects generated with the public Kubric simulator [ 11 ] , 4,000 histories per Kubric family with the restitution and initial velocity drawn per scene. Splits are by source scene, and 10 % 10\% of training scenes are held out for selecting the learning rate and KL weight.
With P = 4 P=4 histories per update, each run draws 600 histories from the training pool and uses each at most once, so a Physion all-but-one run removes on the order of 15 histories of the held-out scenario. The held-out runs repeat the full training of every method on the mixture without the falling family, and on the mixture without each of the eight Physion scenarios in turn, with the configuration selected once on the full mixture.
No test image of any benchmark is used for training or selection.
The experiments reported here took about 81,000 81{,}000 A100 GPU hours, of which 15,500 15{,}500 were training, mostly the 240 Physion all-but-one runs and the 30 Cosmos-14B runs, and the rest evaluation, dominated by the eight Physion continuations per test video, the 128 generations per PisaBench frame, the 64 generations per Kubric test scene and the 14B evaluations.

The training readout of falling and thrown objects tracks the object with CoTracker3 [ 17 ] and intersects the track with a ground line estimated in the first frame.
For falling objects the outcome cell is the landing frame.
For Kubric families it is the landing position along the throw direction, the number of bounces before rest or the exit direction after the collision, where position and direction fall into eight cells bounded by the octiles of the recorded training videos of the family, computed once before training.
The training readout of Physion contact tests the adjacency of SAM 2 [ 36 ] masks of the two queried objects in the last frame, with a separate class for videos in which either object is lost.
Evaluation always uses the official judges, namely the PISA mask pipeline, the Physion readout protocol of SlotFormer [ 50 ] , PAWEval and the vision-language readout of CaliBench.
Readout errors are measured on 200 held-out recorded videos against simulator ground truth and on 200 generations per checkpoint against the agreement of two annotators.

对于掉落的物体,结果细胞是着陆框架.
对库布里克家庭来说,这是沿投掷方向的着陆位置、休息前的弹跳次数或碰撞后的出口方向,其位置和方向落在八个细胞中,这些细胞由该家庭记录的训练录像的八分块相连,在训练前计算一次。
Physion 接触器的训练读取测试了最后一个帧中两个被询问对象的SAM 2 [36] 口罩的附着性,另外为丢失任一物体的视频设置一个课.
评价总是使用官方评委,即PISA面具管道,SlotFormer的Physion读出协议[50],PAWEval和Cali Bench的视觉语言读出.

blocks.en:
RLVR-World uses the negative L1 plus LPIPS distance to the recorded frames with GRPO advantages, which on flow models amounts to Flow-GRPO with this reward.
Flow-GRPO uses the negative training-readout distance with group mean and standard-deviation normalization.
The three PISA-ORO variants backpropagate the segmentation, flow and depth rewards through the decoder as in the original work, which explains their higher memory.
DynamicsBoost builds preference pairs from continuations conditioned on recorded prefixes of different lengths and trains with its asymmetric DPO loss.
DiverseGRPO adds its cluster-based diversity reward, computed by spectral clustering of frozen video-encoder features of the group, with the default weight of the original work.
DPH-RL replaces the reverse KL penalty of Flow-GRPO by the forward KL to samples of the base model.
EBFT [ 16 ] matches mean features of generated and recorded futures with its alignment-minus-diversity reward on features of a frozen copy of the generator, and success-count normalization [ 43 ] divides the record-agreement reward by the number of agreeing generations, both with the group sampling and readouts of SibPO.
SibPO with M = 0 M=0 uses Eq. ( 4 ) with ω g = 1 \omega_{g}=1 , which is the quadratic score of the readout cells, together with the leave-one-out baseline and running scale of Eq. ( 5 ) , so it shares every setting of SibPO except the weight.
For the decoded robot futures, σ \sigma is the median L2 distance between pairs of base-model generations of the same training history, computed once on 200 training histories before post-training.
SFT continues flow-matching training [ 25 , 28 ] on recorded futures for the same number of GPU hours.
On the token model iVideoGPT, SFT continues likelihood training, DynamicsBoost applies its asymmetric DPO loss to token log-probabilities, DiverseGRPO and DPH-RL modify the GRPO update of RLVR-World as above, and Flow-GRPO and PISA-ORO do not apply, since they require a stochastic flow sampler or a differentiable decoder path.
blocks.zh:
RLVR-World使用负L1加LPIPS距离到具有GRPO优势的录制帧,在流量模型上就相当于带有这种奖励的Flow-GRPO.
Flow-GROPO使用负培训读取距离,与组平均和标准的调试正常化.
三种PISA-ORO变体通过解码器与原作一样,背向分解,流和深度奖励,这解释了它们的较高内存.
DynamicsBoost通过附加条件在记录的不同长度和列车的前缀上建立偏好对,其不对称的DPO损失.
DiverseGRPO增加了其基于集群的多样性奖励,通过对组的冷冻视频编码器特性的光谱分组来计算,并带有原作品的默认重量.
DPH-RL将Flow-GRPO的反向KL罚则替换为前向KL到基模型样本.
EBFT [16] 将生成和记录的期货的平均特征与其对被冻结的生成者副本的特征进行比对-减去-多样性的奖励相匹配,成功计数正常化[43]将记录-协议奖励除以同意代数,同时与SibPO的分组抽样和读出.
SibPO与M=0 M=0使用Eq. (4)使用QQ = 1\omega_{g}=1,这是读出单元格的四极分数,加上Eq. (5)的一离线基线和运行尺度,所以除了重量外,它共享SibPO的每一个设置.
对于解码的机器人未来,\\sigma是相同训练历史的一对基模世代之间的中位数L2距离,在训练后200个训练历史上计算一次.
SFT继续就相同数目的GPU时数记录期货进行流量匹配训练[25,28].
在代号模型iVideoGPT上,SFT继续概率训练,DynamicsBoost将其不对称的DPO损失应用于代号对数概率,DiversityGRPO和DPH-RL如上修改了RLVR-World的GRPO更新,Flow-GRPO和PISA-ORO不适用,因为它们需要分色流采样器或不同的可解码器路径.

Figure S1 : Why a PisaBench first frame admits many landing times. For each first frame, the curves mark where the object would first touch the ground if it were placed at depths between 2 and 18 m with the camera height of the generator, and the color gives the frame of contact.
The recorded video (star) realizes one of these depths, so the analytic distribution of landing times has a width that the frame cannot resolve.
blocks.zh:
图S1:为什么比萨奔驰第一帧会承认多次登陆. 对于每一个第一帧,曲线标出如果物体被放置在2至18米与发电机相机高度的深度之间,会首先触摸地面的位置,颜色给出了接触帧.
被录制的视频(星)意识到其中的一个深度,因此登陆时间的分析分布具有一个宽度,帧无法解决.

blocks.en:
The protocol of PISA [ 21 ] uses simulated drops in which the image of an object at a given height is consistent with a range of depths, because the depth of the object cannot be read from the frame and the camera height varies between 0.4 and 0.6 m. Figure S1 shows how a single first frame maps to a family of possible first-contact positions and frames.
For each of the 50 first frames, the simulator provides 1,000 Monte Carlo landing times quantized to frames, and each model generates 128 futures.
The KS statistic compares the two samples, and the reported KS distance is its mean over frames.
Because a deviation in location alone also raises the KS statistic, we report the IQR ratio next to it, and only the IQR ratio indicates concentration.
The readout dispersion ratio S S divides the mean pairwise distance of generated landing readouts by that of simulated ones and corresponds directly to S ⁡ ( P h ) / S ⁡ ( Q h ) S(P_{h})/S(Q_{h}) .
Most models are rejected by the KS test on most frames, since 128 generations resolve very small differences, so the rejection count carries little information and we report the mean statistic.
blocks.zh:
PISA [21] 的协议使用模拟投影,其中特定高度的物体图像与深度范围一致,因为物体的深度不能从帧读取,相机高度在0.4至0.6米之间. 图S1显示一个单一的第一帧图如何映射到一个可能的第一接触位置和帧的家族.
对于50个第一帧中的每一个,模拟器提供了1000个蒙特卡洛登陆时间量化到帧,每个模型产生128个期货.
KS统计比较了这两个样本,所报告的KS距离是其平均值超出框架.
由于仅位置偏差也提高了KS统计值,我们报告旁边的IQR比,只有IQR比表示浓度.
读出散射比SS将生成的着陆读出的平均对比距离除以模拟读出,直接对应SQQ(Ph)/SQ(Qh)S(P_{h)/S(Q_{h).
大多数模型都被大多数帧上的KS测试所拒绝,因为128代人解决了非常小的差异,所以拒绝计数携带的信息很少,我们报告平均统计.

blocks.en:
The 1,200 test videos cover eight scenarios with balanced contact outcomes.
From the visible prefix, each model generates eight continuations, and the official readout returns a contact probability per continuation.
The video-level prediction is the mean probability, accuracy thresholds it at 0.5 0.5 , the Pearson correlation with the mean human response is computed within each scenario and averaged, and Cohen’s κ \kappa is averaged over individual participants.
The human response measures how ambiguous a prefix appears to observers and differs from the true probability, so we also report the fair Brier score of the eight binary readouts against the true outcome, the only proper score among these metrics.
Pearson correlation and κ \kappa can increase when predictions become sharper while keeping their ranking, so they are read together with the Brier score.
blocks.zh:
1,200个测试视频涵盖8个情景,具有平衡的接触结果.
从可见的前缀中,每个模型产生8个续作,官方的读出返回每次续作的接触概率.
视频层面的预测是平均概率,精确阈值为0.5 0.5,皮尔逊与人类平均反应的关联在每种情景中计算并平均,科恩的\kappa比个别参与者平均.
人类的反应测量了一个前缀在观察者眼中有多模棱两可,与真实概率不同,因此我们也报告八个二进制读取结果的公平布赖尔分数,这是这些度数中唯一适当的分数.
皮尔逊相关和oble\kappa在预测变得尖锐的同时保持其排名时可以增加,因此它们与布里尔分数一起阅读.

blocks.en:
PAWBench [ 35 ] generates 50 videos per scene for 25 calibration scenes and reports the total variation distance to the reference outcome distribution, averaged over scenes whose outcomes pass the readability threshold, together with the coverage of legal outcomes on 25 further scenes.
CaliBench [ 37 ] generates 32 videos for each of nine scenes with analytic outcome distributions and reports mnTV, which subtracts the finite-sample expectation of the TVD under a calibrated model and penalizes unreadable generations.
Neither benchmark shares a mechanism with the training data.
blocks.zh:
PAWBench [35] 为25场校准场景制作50个视频,并报告与参考结果分发的总差异距离,平均在结果超过可读性阈值的场景上进行,同时在另外25场景上报道法律结果.
Cali Bench [37] 为9个场景中每个场景生成32个视频,并附有分析结果分发和报告mnTV,这减少了TVD在校准模型下的有限-样本预期,并惩罚了无法阅读的一代人.
两个基准都与培训数据共享一个机制。

blocks.en:
The 150 test scenes (50 each for throws, bounces and collisions) come from source scenes that never occur in training.
For each scene we keep the rendered first frame and re-run the simulator 500 times with the restitution, mass and initial speed drawn from the ranges of the training generator, conditioned on the visible initial pose, so the reference distribution covers exactly what the frame leaves open.
The outcome is the landing position along the throw direction, the number of bounces before rest and the exit direction after the collision.
The evaluation readout segments the object with SAM 2 and intersects its mask with the ground plane, which differs from the CoTracker3 readout used for training, and each family enters the mean KS distance with equal weight.
This split is ours and is reported in its own column, separately from the public benchmarks.
blocks.zh:
150个测试场景(每个场景50个用于投掷,弹跳和碰撞)来自训练中从未发生的源场景.
对于每个场景,我们保留了被渲染的第一帧,并重新运行模拟器500次,其还原,质量和初始速度从训练生成器的射程中抽取出来,以可见的初始姿势为条件,因此参考分布涵盖了帧留下的准确内容.
其结果是沿投掷方向的着陆位置,休息前的弹跳次数以及碰撞后的出口方向.
评估读取器将对象与SAM 2进行分解,并将它的面具与地面平面相交,这与用于训练的CoTracker3读取器不同,每个家族都以同等重量进入平均KS距离.
这种分割是我们的,在自己的栏目中报告,与公共基准分开。

For the base model and Flow-GRPO we search the guidance scale over { 0.5 , 0.75 , 1 } ​ w 0 \{0.5,0.75,1\}\,w_{0} and the sampler noise multiplier over { 1 , 1.2 , … , 2 } \{1,1.2,\dots,2\} on the validation scenes and keep the setting whose pooled readout dispersion ratio S S is closest to one, which is 0.75 ​ w 0 0.75\,w_{0} with multiplier 1.6 1.6 for Flow-GRPO and 0.75 ​ w 0 0.75\,w_{0} with multiplier 1.2 1.2 for the base model.

blocks.en:
PisaBench trajectory metrics compare object masks and trajectories of one generation with the recorded video on 361 real videos.
Physics-IQ [ 30 ] compares generated and real motion in 198 real image-to-video scenes with four runs each, and VBench-I2V [ 15 ] measures consistency, motion smoothness, dynamic degree and image quality on its official suite.
A model that suppresses motion can score high on consistency, so the dynamic degree is always reported with it.
blocks.zh:
比萨奔驰轨迹度量衡将一代人的物体口罩和轨迹与361个真视频的录制视频进行比较.
Physics-IQ [30] 在198个真实的图像对视频场景中将生成和真实的运动分别与4个运行进行对比,V Bench-I2V [15]在其官方套房中测量一致性,运动光滑度,动态度和图像质量.
抑制运动的模型可以在一致性上获得很高的分数,因此动态度总是随它一起报告.

blocks.en:
For iVideoGPT [ 48 ] we follow RLVR-World [ 49 ] : multi-step prediction on RT-1 [ 4 ] is scored by MSE, PSNR, SSIM and LPIPS, and Real2Sim evaluation rolls out policies in the world model, records task completion with a criterion fixed before evaluation, and compares the resulting success rates with real-robot success rates.
The original protocol covers four RT-1 and RT-1-X checkpoints on six drawer tasks. We extend it to the five open policies with real-robot evaluations in SIMPLER [ 24 ] , namely RT-1 at the beginning, at 15 % 15\% and at the end of training, RT-1-X and Octo-Base [ 33 ] , and to the ten Google Robot task variants with reported real-robot success rates, namely picking a can in three orientations, moving an object near another and opening and closing the top, middle and bottom drawers. This gives 50 policy-task pairs, each with 20 world-model rollouts from fixed initial frames, and the real-robot rates are taken from SIMPLER without new robot trials.
Each history receives 100 generations, of which the first 32 measure dispersion as the mean pairwise L1 distance of decoded futures.
blocks.zh:
对于iVideoGPT[48],我们遵循RLVR-World[49]:RT-1[4]的多步预测由MSE,PSNR,SSIM和LPIPS评分,Real2Sim评分在世界模型中推出政策,记录任务完成情况,在评分前设定一个标准,并将由此产生的成功率与实际机器人评分率进行比较.
最初的礼宾包括四个RT-1和RT-1-X检查站,执行六个抽屉任务. 我们把它推广到在SIMPLER[24]中具有真机器人评价的五个开放政策,即RT-1在开头,15%++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++ 这给出了50个政策任务对,每对都有20个从固定的初始框架推出的世界模型,而实机器人的速率则取自SIMPLER,没有进行新的机器人试验.
每段历史都获得100代,其中前32位测量散射值为解码期货的平均对比L1距离.

blocks.en:
Table S4 completes the full comparison on Wan2.2 and CogVideoX.
SibPO has the highest correlation with human contact predictions in both families by a small margin ( 0.372 0.372 and 0.351 0.351 ), while its accuracy stays slightly below that of DPH-RL on Wan2.2 and of the base model on CogVideoX, consistent with the fact that accuracy rewards committing to the likelier outcome.
Single-video metrics of SibPO stay within the range of the other post-training methods in both families, and DynamicsBoost again attains the highest dynamic degree, as on Cosmos.
On the Kubric split, the inverse-frequency weight lowers the KS distance by 0.012 0.012 on Wan2.2, 0.003 0.003 on CogVideoX and 0.014 0.014 at 14B, less than on PisaBench because the split is less ambiguous, and EBFT, whose feature repulsion also acts on appearance, has the second-highest dynamic degree.
EBFT is behind DPH-RL on the Kubric split in all three families although it is ahead on PisaBench in two. Its repulsion acts on features of the whole video and also spreads outcomes that the first frame determines, which costs most on the less ambiguous split, as uniform noise over-widens the narrowest PisaBench frames ( Appendix F ).
On the held-out benchmarks ( Table S4 and Table S5 ), no difference between SibPO and the strongest compared method excludes zero in any model, while single comparison is worse than the base model on CaliBench in Wan2.2 and at 14B, as on Cosmos-2B. CogVideoX is the exception, where single comparison slightly improves on its less concentrated base model.
blocks.zh:
表S4是对Wan2.2和CogVideoX的全面比较。

SibPO的单视度量度在两个家庭的其他培训后方法范围内,DynamicsBoost再次达到最高动态度,如Cosmos。

At 14B parameters, every method is trained on the same mixture for 150 updates with three seeds ( Table S2 and Table S5 ).
The 14B base model starts narrower than the 2B model (IQR ratio 0.59 0.59 against 0.71 0.71 ), single comparison narrows it further ( 0.45 0.45 for Flow-GRPO), and SibPO covers 51 % 51\% of the distance from the base IQR ratio to one ( 0.80 0.80 ).
Single-video metrics at 14B follow the 2B pattern: SibPO stays within the range of the other post-training methods (L2 8.4 8.4 against 7.9 7.9 – 8.9 × 10 − 2 8.9\times 10^{-2} ), and DynamicsBoost again attains the highest dynamic degree.

Figure S2 shows two PAWBench scenes whose mechanisms never appear in training.
Flow-GRPO repeats the same pin count or tableware outcome in several of six generations, while SibPO keeps several outcomes, which matches the held-out columns, where single comparison ends worse than the base model. Figure S3 shows that single continuations in real scenes remain physically comparable between Flow-GRPO and SibPO.

图S2显示两个PAWBench场景,其机制从未出现在训练中.
Flow-GROPO在六代数中重复相同的针数或表盘结果,而SibPO保留了几种结果,这些结果与被搁置的列相匹配,其中的单比结果比基准模型差. 图S3显示,在真实场景中单个续作在Flow-GRPO和SibPO之间仍然具有物理可比性.

blocks.en:
The autoregressive iVideoGPT samples discrete tokens, so siblings share only the key-value cache of the visible history and every token is sampled independently.
Retraining RLVR-World with our seeds reproduces the released checkpoint closely ( 0.491 0.491 against 0.486 0.486 MSE and 2.47 2.47 against 2.41 2.41 dispersion).
The Euclidean L2 version of SibPO keeps 94 % 94\% of the base dispersion and the L1 plus LPIPS version 90 % 90\% , against 68 % 68\% for RLVR-World, although the latter gains less in Real2Sim error ( 12.2 × 10 − 2 12.2\times 10^{-2} ), and the higher MSE of both is the price of not concentrating on the conditional mean, since a model whose generations for one history spread like the data has a larger expected distance to any single recorded future.
Among the added baselines in Table S3 , DPH-RL keeps most of the base dispersion and is the strongest alternative for policy evaluation, while DiverseGRPO keeps less dispersion than DPH-RL because its cluster reward acts on appearance features.
The rank correlation between the absolute Real2Sim error and the centrality 1 − 2 ​ | s − 0.5 | 1-2|s-0.5| of the real success rate s s is 0.38 0.38 for retrained RLVR-World, 0.24 0.24 for DPH-RL and 0.15 0.15 for SibPO with L2, so the error of single comparison concentrates on policy-task pairs that succeed about half of the time, where a world model that commits each rollout to one outcome estimates a rate of zero or one.
blocks.zh:
自动回转的iVideoGPT样本离散符,因此兄弟姐妹只分享可见历史的密钥-值缓存,每个符都是独立样本.
使用我们的种子再训练RLVR-World复制了已放行的检查站(0.491 0.491对0.486 0486MSE和2.47 2.47对2.41 2.41分散)。
SibPO的Euclidean L2版本保留了94%的基数分散度和L1+LPIPS版本的90% 90 \%,而RLVR-World则保留了68% 68 \%,尽管后者在Real2Sim错误(12.2 × 10 − 2 12.2\tims 10^{-2 })中的收益较少,两者中较高的MSE就是不专注于有条件的中间值的代价,因为其一代人像数据一样传播到任何一个记录的未来的预期距离更大。
在表S3中增加的基线中,DPH-RL保持大部分基部分散,是政策评价最强的替代方法,而DiversitiveGRPO则保持比DPH-RL少的分散,因为其集群奖励行为在外观特征上.
绝对Real2Sim误差与中心点1 - 2 S - 0.5 − 1-2s - 0.5 − s 实际成功率的等级关联是:再训练RLVR-World的0.38 0.38,DPH-RL的0.24 0.24,与L2的SibPO的0.15 ,所以单次比较的错误集中在大约一半时间成功的政策任务对上,一个将每次推出一次结果的世界模型估计是0或1。

blocks.en:
Figure S4 : Landing-time spread of released PISA checkpoints. Boxes mark the central 80 % 80\% of first-contact frames over 128 generations for the simulator (green), the supervised checkpoint (gray) and the ORO checkpoint (red) on four first frames.
The star marks the first contact of the recorded video, shown as a film strip. On every frame the ORO window is the narrowest of the three and contains the recorded contact, while the supervised checkpoint stays closer to the simulated width.
blocks.zh:
图S4:释放的PISA检查站的着陆时间分布。 盒式标注了128代以上第一接触架中80%的中央,用于模拟器(绿色),监督检查台(灰色)和ORO检查台(红色)在四个前帧.
该星标志着录制的视频的首次接触,显示为电影条状. 在每个框架上,ORO窗口是三个窗口中最窄的,并包含有记录的接触,而受监督的检查站则保持更接近模拟宽度.

blocks.en:
We evaluate the released Open-Sora [ 55 ] checkpoints of PISA without retraining, using their published trajectory metrics on 361 real videos and our landing-time measurements from 128 generations for each of the 50 PisaBench frames.
The supervised checkpoint (PSFT) has an L2 error of 7.6 × 10 − 2 7.6\times 10^{-2} , a Chamfer distance (CD) of 0.188 0.188 and an IoU of 0.139 0.139 , and its landing times reach a KS distance of 0.277 0.277 with an IQR ratio of 0.81 0.81 and a dispersion ratio S S of 0.87 0.87 .
The ORO checkpoints with segmentation, flow and depth rewards reach L2 errors of 7.5 7.5 , 6.7 6.7 and 6.7 × 10 − 2 6.7\times 10^{-2} , CD of 0.183 0.183 , 0.164 0.164 and 0.159 0.159 and IoU of 0.142 0.142 , 0.136 0.136 and 0.129 0.129 , while their KS distance rises to 0.284 0.284 , 0.296 0.296 and 0.291 0.291 , their IQR ratio falls to 0.74 0.74 , 0.63 0.63 and 0.66 0.66 , and S S falls to 0.80 0.80 , 0.71 0.71 and 0.73 0.73 .
The flow and depth variants thus lower L2 and CD most and also narrow most, while the segmentation variant barely changes L2 and narrows least. A reward that is linear in the model distribution predicts this pairing of trajectory gain and concentration. Figure S4 shows this narrowing on four first frames.
For the ORO checkpoints, the window that contains 80 % 80\% of generated first contacts is about one frame narrower than the simulated window, which spans two and a half to four frames, and it contains the recorded contact on all four frames, so the model has moved its probability mass toward the frames that the recorded futures of similar frames occupy.
blocks.zh:
我们利用361个真实视频上公布的轨迹测量标准, 以及我们从128代人的时间测量,
受监管检查站(PSFT)的L2误差为7.6×10 − 2 7.6\times 10^{-2},Chamfer距离(CD)为0.188 0188,IoU为0.139 0139,着陆时间为KS距离0.277 0.277,IQR比为0.81 0.81,散射比S为0.87 0.87 0.87.
分块、流量和深度奖励的ORO检查站的L2差错为:7.5、6.7、6.7和6.7×10 - 2 6.7 时 10×2 ×2、0.183 0.183、0.164 0.164和 0.159 0.159和IoU为0.142 0142、0.136 0136和0.129 0.129,而其KS差升至0.284 0.284、0.296 0296和0.291 029,其IQR比降至0.74 0.74、0.63 0.63和0.66 0.66,S降至0.80 0.80、0.71 0.71和0.73 0.73。
流和深度变体因此在L2和CD的下位最多,也最窄,而分化变体则勉强改变L2,缩小最小. 在模型分布中线性奖励预示着轨迹增益和集中的这种对称. 图S4显示,这四个框架在缩小。
对 ORO 检查点来说, 包含 80% 80 QQ 生成的首次接触的窗口, 大约比模拟窗口要窄一个框架, 它跨度为 2.5 至 4 个框架, 它包含所有四个框架上记录的接触, 因此模型将其概率质量移向了记录的类似框架的期货所占用的框架 。

blocks.en:
The released RLVR-World checkpoint of iVideoGPT shows the same narrowing with a different architecture and optimizer.
Its single-sample LPIPS is 13.4 × 10 − 2 13.4\times 10^{-2} against 14.8 × 10 − 2 14.8\times 10^{-2} for the base model, and its best-of- N N LPIPS improves only from 13.4 13.4 to 12.35 × 10 − 2 12.35\times 10^{-2} between N = 1 N=1 and N = 100 N=100 , whereas the base model improves from 14.8 14.8 to 12.05 × 10 − 2 12.05\times 10^{-2} and overtakes it at N = 50 N=50 .
A model whose generations for one history lie close together gains little from more samples, which is the behavior of a narrowed distribution.
blocks.zh:
发布iVideoGPT的RLVR-World检查点显示同样以不同的架构和优化器缩小.
它的单样LPIPS为13.4×10−2 13.4\time 10×2}对准14.8×10−2 14.8\time 10×2}基础型,其最佳N型LPIPS仅改进从13.4 13.4×12.35×10−2 12.35\time 10×2}在N=1 N=1和N=100 N=100之间,而基础型由14.8 14.8×12.05×10−2 12.05\time 10×2}并在N=50 N=50时超标.
一个几代相距相近的模型 从更多的样本中得益甚微 也就是缩小分布的行为

Each row changes one design of SibPO (gray: leave-one-out baseline, independent noise, G = 8 G=8 , with the sibling weight varied in Table 2 ) and keeps the rest fixed, on trained mechanisms, with three seeds per row.

blocks.en:
The evaluations every 25 updates show how the two pairings reach their endpoints.
Flow-GRPO shrinks the IQR ratio steadily from 0.71 0.71 for the base model to 0.69 0.69 , 0.64 0.64 , 0.59 0.59 , 0.57 0.57 and 0.55 0.55 after 25, 50, 75, 100 and 150 updates, while its KS distance first falls from 0.585 0.585 to 0.301 0.301 at 50 updates and then rises again to 0.329 0.329 .
The first phase corrects the landing delay of the base model, which both pairings share, and the second phase is the concentration that single comparison adds once the delay is gone.
SibPO instead widens the distribution from the start, with IQR ratios of 0.78 0.78 , 0.82 0.82 , 0.84 0.84 , 0.85 0.85 and 0.86 0.86 , and its KS distance decreases monotonically to 0.241 0.241 .
Early single-video gains are almost identical, with PisaBench simulated-scene IoU of 0.086 0.086 for Flow-GRPO and 0.088 0.088 for SibPO after 25 updates, so the two methods diverge only after the coarse errors are corrected, at the point where the pairing starts to dominate the update.
The other variants follow the same logic: the cross-history partner narrows from 0.65 0.65 to 0.41 0.41 while its KS distance rises from 0.352 0.352 to 0.372 0.372 .
SibPO and the other sibling-paired variants change their frequency error by less than the variation across seeds over the last 50 updates.
Single comparison is not yet stationary at 150 updates: continued for 450 updates with three seeds, Flow-GRPO narrows further to IQR ratios of 0.53 0.53 , 0.51 0.51 and 0.49 0.49 after 200, 300 and 450 updates with a KS distance of 0.342 0.342 , while SibPO reaches 0.87 0.87 , 0.87 0.87 and 0.88 0.88 with a KS distance of 0.236 0.236 .
The main budget therefore understates the concentration of single comparison, while SibPO is already stationary.
blocks.zh:
每25次更新一次评价,就显示两种配对是如何达到终点的.
Flow-GRPO在25,50,75,100和150更新后将IQR比从基型的0.71 0.71稳步缩小到0.69 0.69,0.64 0.64,0.59 0.59,0.57 0.57和0.55 0.55,而其KS距离最初在50更新后从0.585 0.585降至0.301 0.39.
第一阶段纠正了碱基模型的落地延迟,两者配对共享,第二阶段是单次比较在延迟消失后增加的浓度.
SibPO反而从一开始就扩大了分布,IQR比为0.78 0.78,0.82 0.82,0.84 0.84,0.85 0.85和0.86 0.86,其KS距离单调缩小到0.241 0.241.
早期的单视增益几乎完全相同,比萨本奇模拟-场景IoU在Flow-GRPO为0.086 0.086,西布波为0.088 0.088在更新25后,因此两种方法只在粗差错误纠正后才会出现差异,此时配对开始主导更新.
其他变体遵循相同的逻辑:跨历史伴侣从0.65 0.65缩小到0.41 0.41。 KS距离从0.352 0.352提高到0.372 0.372.
SibPO和其他兄弟会的变种改变频率误差小于过去50年更新的种子间变异.
单项比较尚未固定在150个更新中:450个更新中继续有3个种子, Flow-GRPO进一步缩小到IQR比0.53 0.53,0.51 0.51和0.49 0.49,在200,300和450更新后,KS距离为0.342 0.342,而SibPO达到0.87 0.87,0.87 0.87和0.88 0.88,KS距离为0.236 0.236.
因此,主要预算低估了单一比较的集中度,而SibPO已经固定下来.

blocks.en:
Figure 3 of the main paper shows the advantages of three estimators on one group of the running example and on a PisaBench group.
With six of eight generations showing contact, group standard-deviation normalization gives the no-contact generation the same advantage with and without the sibling term, as Part 3 of Proposition 2 states, while the leave-one-out advantage of SibPO raises it on average.
Part 3 is exact only for two outcome cells. PisaBench readouts have many cells and the Physion readout has a third cell for lost objects, so standardized advantages keep part of the sibling term there, which is consistent with the group standard-deviation rows of Table S6 lying between SibPO and Flow-GRPO. Their approach to Flow-GRPO as G G grows is measured and has no derivation in this paper.
blocks.zh:
主论文图3显示了三个估计器对一组运行中的例子和比萨奔驰组的优点.
随着八代六位中六位显示接触,团体标准缓和正常化使得无接触一代拥有和没有兄弟术语的相同优势,如提案2第3部分的状态,而SibPO的一退出优势则平均提高.
第三部分只针对两个结果细胞。 Pisa Bench读取有多个单元格,Physion读取有第三个单元格用于丢失对象,因此标准化的优点是保留了部分兄弟姐妹名词在那里,这与位于SibPO和Flow-GRPO之间的Table S6的组标准调取行一致. 随着GG的增长,它们对待流动-GRPO的方法是衡量的,本文没有引申。

blocks.en: Figure S5 : Partners from other histories keep the pooled rate and collapse each history. Two Physion inputs for which 29 % 29\% and 70 % 70\% of people predict contact, six generations each.

blocks.en:
The cross-history control of Figure S5 reaches a high Physion accuracy with the lowest IQR ratio, because accuracy rewards committing to the likelier outcome of each history and the pooled frequency is the only quantity that its pairing constrains.
Batch-level diversity terms and distribution-matching objectives that compare sets of generations across histories are subject to the same blind spot.
blocks.zh:
图S5的跨历史控制以最低的IQR比达到高的光谱精度,因为准确性奖励承诺每个历史更相似的结果和集合频率是其配对限制的唯一数量.
比较各代不同历史的批量层次多样性术语和分布比对目标,都受制于同一个盲点。

blocks.en:
Figure S6 : Generated contact frequencies follow the ambiguity of the first frame only under SibPO. Four generations per Physion frame, with the share of people predicting contact on the left.
Flow-GRPO commits to one outcome even when people are split ( 48 % 48\% and 49 % 49\% ), while SibPO keeps both outcomes there and largely agrees with people on the clear-cut frames.
blocks.zh:
图S6:生成的接触频率仅跟随SibPO下的第一个帧的模糊性. 四代每physion帧,左侧有预测接触者的比例.
Flow-GRPO承诺,即使人被拆散(48% 48 % 和49% 49 % ) , 但SibPO将两者都保留在那里,并在明确框架上与人基本一致。

blocks.en:
Figure S7 : Contact frequencies across the range of human agreement. Twelve generations from the base model, Flow-GRPO and SibPO for Physion frames with about 25 % 25\% , 70 % 70\% and 95 % 95\% of people predicting contact, in four scenarios.
Each dot is the official readout of one generation, filled for contact. Flow-GRPO converts ambiguous frames into near-unanimous outcomes, while the base model and SibPO keep both outcomes on them.
blocks.zh:
图S7:人类协议范围内的接触频率。 在四种情况下,12代人从基准模型Flow-GRPO和SibPO到光电帧,预测接触的人比例分别为25%、25%、70%、70%、95%和95%。
每个点是一代人的正式读出,填充用于联系. Flow-GROPO将模棱两可的帧转换成近乎一致的结果,而基模型和SibPO则保留着这两个结果.

blocks.en:
Figure S6 shows four generations per Physion frame across the range of human agreement, where all models agree with people on clear-cut frames and only SibPO keeps both outcomes on split ones. Figure S7 extends Figure S6 to twelve frames and twelve generations each.
At 95 % 95\% human agreement all three models produce contact almost always.
At 25 % 25\% and 70 % 70\% , Flow-GRPO produces the majority outcome of the recorded futures in at least 11 of 12 generations on every frame.
SibPO keeps both outcomes on all eight of these frames, but its proportions do not follow the human split frame by frame: at 25 % 25\% it produces contact in 2 to 5 of 12 generations, and at 70 % 70\% its contact share ranges from 4 of 12 on Contain to 11 of 12 on Link, so on Contain and Collide most of its generations show no contact although most people predict contact.
Averaged over the eight frames, the absolute gap between the generated and the human contact share is 0.155 0.155 for SibPO, 0.145 0.145 for the base model and 0.222 0.222 for Flow-GRPO.
On these twelve frames SibPO therefore keeps the spread of the base model without matching people more closely. Its gains in Brier score and human correlation in Table 1 are measured on the full test set and are not visible at this sample size.
blocks.zh:
图S6显示的是跨人类协议范围每个光谱框架的四代人,其中所有模型都与人们就清晰的光谱框架达成一致,只有SibPO将两种结果都保留在分裂的光谱上. 图S7将图S6延伸至12帧,每帧12代.
95%的人类协议 所有三种模式几乎总是产生接触。
Flow-GRPO以25% 25 + 和70% 70 + = 的比例,在12代人中,每代人中至少有11人创造了记录期货的大多数结果。
锡布 PO将这两种结果都保留在这8个框架上,但其比例并不按框架进行划分:在12代中的2至5代中,其25%产生接触,在70 % 的接触份额中,其联系份额从12年中的4个到12年中的11个不等,因此在Link上,Control和Collide的大部分几代人没有显示接触,尽管大多数人预测接触。
平均8帧,生成的与人类接触份额的绝对差距为:SibPO0.155,基型0.1450.145,Flow-GRPO0.222.
因此,在这十二帧上,SibPO保持了基础模型的传播,而没有更紧密地匹配人. 它在布赖尔分数和表1中的人文相关性的增益在全测试集中进行测量,在这个样本大小上是不可见的.

blocks.en:
Proposition 1 predicts that single comparison loses nothing where the true outcome distribution is narrow and loses most where it is wide, because only then does the mode differ from the distribution.
Ordering the 50 PisaBench frames of Cosmos-Predict2.5-2B by simulated landing-time width into five quintiles of ten frames tests this prediction. blocks.en:
Two alternative explanations of the main results can be checked on Cosmos-Predict2.5-2B with diagnostics recorded during training.
The first is that SibPO is better calibrated only because it moves less from the base model.
After 150 updates, SibPO has a KL of 0.089 0.089 to the reference, below the methods rewarded against the record ( 0.091 0.091 – 0.159 0.159 ), but SFT and DPH-RL end lower still ( 0.064 0.064 and 0.069 0.069 ) and remain less calibrated, so the amount of movement does not determine the outcome frequencies.
The second is that the methods exploit the training readout.
On 200 validation videos, the agreement between the training readout and the official judge stays between 0.85 0.85 and 0.87 0.87 for every method after 25 and after 150 updates ( 0.856 0.856 and 0.862 0.862 for SibPO, 0.860 0.860 and 0.857 0.857 for Flow-GRPO), so no method learns to produce videos on which the two programs disagree.
The KL of all reinforcement-learning methods grows fastest during the first 100 updates and flattens afterwards, while the IQR ratio of single comparison keeps decreasing slowly ( Appendix F ).

经过150次更新,SibPO对参考的KL为0.089 0.089,低于对记录的奖励方法(0.091 0.091 – 0.159 0.159),但SFT和DPH-RL端仍然较低(0.064 0.064 和 0.069 0.069),并保持较低的校准,因此运动量无法确定结果频率.
第二,这些方法利用了培训读取。
在200个验证视频上,训练读取与官方法官之间的协议在25个及150个更新后,每个方法都保留在0.85 0.85至0.87 0.87之间(SibPO的0.856 0.856和0.862 0.862,Flow-GRPO的0.860 0.860和0.857 0.857),因此没有任何方法可以学习制作两个程序不同意的视频.
所有强化学习方法的KL在最初的100次更新中增长最快,之后的扁平,而单次比较的IQR比则持续缓慢下降(附录F.).
